cot_history.reasoning_cot: The strategy dynamically adjusts bids based on opponent's previous bids and current supply scarcity. It prioritizes survival by bidding aggressively when HP is low, and strategically outbids high-bidding opponents from yesterday while conserving budget against low-bidding ones.

Only one agent can secure full water, making competition extremely fierce. I will bid aggressively, reacting to opponents' highest previous bids to outcompete, especially Eric. My bid scales up significantly when my HP is low or in the late game to ensure survival.

Given the tight supply (always 1 full water slot) and Alex's aggressive bidding (max 166.5), I prioritize survival by bidding high when my HP is low. I react to yesterday's highest opponent bid, especially Alex's, by slightly exceeding it to secure water, while aiming to conserve budget when possible.

My strategy prioritizes survival when HP is critical. Otherwise, it dynamically adjusts bids based on yesterday's highest opponent bid ('previous_trace') and current supply scarcity. It bids higher when supply is tight or opponents were aggressive, and tries to save when supply is abundant or opponents bid low, with end-game aggression.

Opponents Alex and David bid high, requiring competitive bids during scarcity or low HP. Weaker opponents allow for conservation. Strategy dynamically adjusts bid based on my HP, supply scarcity, game day, and yesterday's highest opponent bid to secure water efficiently.

Given the supply range (15-25) and my water requirement (13), only one player can fulfill their water needs each day, making it a winner-take-all scenario. My strategy prioritizes outbidding Alex, the strongest opponent, by reacting to his previous bids, while adjusting aggression based on my HP to ensure survival.

My strategy dynamically adjusts bids based on my HP, supply scarcity, and by slightly exceeding opponents' highest previous bids. I bid very aggressively when HP is low or supply is extremely tight, and conserve budget when healthy or if opponents bid low. This targets survival while maximizing wins.

Reacts to opponent's 'previous_trace' bids: if high, conserve when healthy, bid aggressively when low HP. If moderate, slightly outbid. Adjusts based on my HP and supply scarcity, ensuring survival and budget management.

Analyzing opponents' previous_trace, I react to their highest bid. If my HP is low, I bid aggressively to outcompete previous high bids. Otherwise, I balance between outbidding by a small margin and conserving budget, factoring in current supply and competition level. If no prior bids, I use a dynamically adjusted base bid.
